parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description to add to the common parameter. The description can be up to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The parameter name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name can be up to 200 characters in length and cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The parameter value. The value can be up to 4,096 characters in length.
